events.title: September ends with 아스널 as Premier League leaders, with 맨체스터 유나이티드 second. The previous month-end leaders 블랙번 로버스 have slipped into fifth place, while 레스터 시티 (without a top division league title to their name) currently occupy third place and are just a single point off the top spot, and 첼시 occupy fourth place. A terrible run of form has pushed 사우샘프턴 into bottom place, while 반즐리's reasonable start to their first top division season has given way to a series of heavy defeats and they now occupy the next lowest position in the league. The final place in the relegation zone is occupied by 셰필드 웬즈데이. 노팅엄 포리스트 continue to lead the way in Division One, with surprise promotion contenders 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 now second. QPR have crept into the playoff zone at the expense of 포츠머스 (who have slumped to 19th). 브래드퍼드 시티, 셰필드 유나이티드 and 스윈던 타운 complete the top six.

events.text: 수상 대상 연도는 1997년입니다. 정확한 발표일이 미확보되어 연말부터 공개하는 연도 단위 기록입니다. 아래 날짜를 실제 시상일로 해석하지 마세요.

events.title: 주요 이적 · 연간 기록
events.text: 연도만 확인된 역사적 이적입니다. 정확한 이적일을 만들지 않고 연말부터 공개합니다.

events.title: 1997 draws to a close with 맨체스터 유나이티드 now leading by a five-point margin over their nearest contenders 블랙번 로버스. 첼시, 리버풀 and 리즈 유나이티드 complete the top five, but 아스널 are now sixth and now need something little short of a miracle to bring the Premier League trophy to Highbury . Meanwhile, 반즐리 prop up the top flight, while 에버턴 and 토트넘 홋스퍼 complete the bottom three. 미들즈브러 and 노팅엄 포리스트 are level on points at the top of Division One, with the playoff zone being occupied by 셰필드 유나이티드, 찰턴 애슬레틱, 선덜랜드 and 울버햄프턴 원더러스 .

An unlikely bid for a UEFA Cup place is coming from 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 코번트리 시티, two means who narrowly avoided relegation last season. Meanwhile, 반즐리, 볼턴 원더러스 and 크리스털 팰리스 continue to occupy the relegation zone. 노팅엄 포리스트 remain top of Division One, two points ahead of second placed 미들즈브러 and four points ahead of third placed 선덜랜드. 찰턴 애슬레틱, 셰필드 유나이티드 and a resurgent 입스위치 타운 complete the top six.

Meanwhile, 애스턴 빌라 have emerged as surprise contenders for a UEFA Cup place after spending most of the season battling relegation, and there will also be a UEFA Cup place for the seventh-placed club if 아스널 beat 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 in the FA Cup final next month. At the other end of the table, 반즐리 and 볼턴 원더러스 remain in the bottom three, but there is still a threat of relegation for 토트넘 홋스퍼 and 에버턴 as well as a 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 side who came close to winning the title last season and the season before. 윔블던, who only need two points from their final three games to achieve safety, are the only other team under threat of relegation. 노팅엄 포리스트 have sealed an immediate return to the top flight as Division One champions, while 미들즈브러, 선덜랜드 and 찰턴 애슬레틱 are still fighting it out for second place. 셰필드 유나이티드 and 버밍엄 시티 are challenging each other for the final playoff place.

It is the first time in their history that they will be playing in the third tier of the English league. They are also the first former winners of a European trophy to be relegated to the third tier of their domestic league.

The UEFA Cup places go to 리버풀 , 첼시 , 리즈 유나이티드 , 블랙번 로버스 and 애스턴 빌라 . 볼턴 원더러스 , 반즐리 and 크리스털 팰리스 are relegated. Bolton were the last team to go down – their 2–0 defeat at 첼시 meaning that a 1–1 draw with 코번트리 시티 at Goodison Park was enough to achieve survival on goal difference for 에버턴.
